_comment: How each tag's total spreads over its states. Weight = (arable heatmap mass + floor_permille/1000 x area) x (1 + city_boost x named city hubs + canon_city_boost x canon cities) x multiplier,
from state_weights.json (derived: generate_pop_history.py --refresh-weights). 'share' (fraction of the tag total) overrides weight entirely for that state. Every override carries source + why.
